rationale.consistency: Follows existing patterns: per-option special cases in evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock, slices helpers, typed-assertion errors like 'servers'/'log'; comments match house style.
rationale.edge_cases: Multiple order options chain via existingVal; invalid order errors before any state changes; nil existingVal falls back to a cloned default; plugin init order preserved via Clone.
rationale.scope: All changes serve the requirement; options-map copy and RegisterDirectiveOrder clone are justified by reuse/aliasing concerns, though the latter is a slight opportunistic cleanup.
rationale.readability: Threading 'order' explicitly is clear; parameter position varies between functions and some comments are wordy, but intent is easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: No global mutation, no locks, per-adaptation cloned slices, options map copied, type mismatch returns error rather than panicking; race-free by construction.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit parameter beats hidden global, but the 'order' string special case in evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock couples it to parseOptOrder's contract; extra positional param on several helpers adds mild churn.
